messages:
Jordan: Hey everyone — brand new hire here. MacBook Pro (M2, macOS 13.6) is stuck in a boot loop after it finished 'Installing updates' and the MDM profile merge prompt never showed. Getting repeated message: "Cannot install profile: conflicting payload". Anyone from IT who can help? I'm remote in PST. /cc @Tanner (IT) @Lindsey (IT)
Tanner (IT): Hi Jordan — welcome! Sorry about that. Could you capture the verbose boot log? If you can boot to recovery and open Terminal run:
```
log show --last 1h | grep -i mdm
```
Also paste the exact error text.
Jordan: Thanks Tanner. I can boot to recovery. Here's last bit of the log:
```
2026-07-02 08:17:23.123 com.apple.mobileprofiled[123]: profile installation failed: payloads conflict (com.redwood.mdm.network->com.redwood.mdm.vpn)
2026-07-02 08:17:23.124 com.apple.MobileDeviceManagement: profile merge aborted
```
Jordan: Also seeing a looping dock icon during boot. No login screen.
Lindsey (IT): That looks like the network/VPN payload has two keys that overlap from previous setup. I can push a deletion task for the conflicting payload, but I'll need device serial. Could you run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial Number"` in recovery? Or send serial from the box bottom sticker.
Jordan: Serial SML12345ABC
Lindsey (IT): Got it. I'll queue a Profile Delete job now. You might need local admin for one step — can you confirm you have temporary admin code? If not I can do a remote OS reinstall without user data.
Jordan: I don't have admin creds — brand new account.
Sara: I can hang on this call and keep you company. Also @devops-bot could you check if device already registered in DEP?
devops-bot: Device SML12345ABC found in DEP: true. Assigned to Redwood-Standard. Pending MDM action: 'merge_failed'.
Lindsey (IT): OK I'm sending the delete. After I push it, try an NVRAM reset and safe boot: hold Option-Command-P-R for 20s, then Shift for safe boot. If still looping we'll do a local reinstall and re-enroll you via our MDM invite link.
Jordan: Thanks! One more Q: will reinstall wipe my onboard projects? I have a git repo with local commits.
Tanner (IT): If we do a reinstall we can try "Reinstall macOS" from recovery which preserves user data usually. But advise to do a Time Machine backup if possible; if not we can try to mount the drive and copy the repo to a USB before reinstall.
Jordan: Appreciate the help. I'll try the NVRAM + safe boot now and report back.
Lindsey (IT): Pushed. Give it 60s and reboot.
Jordan: Rebooted — boot progressed to login screen! MDM prompt showed and profile installed. All good. Thanks everyone :tada:
Tanner (IT): Great. Marking resolved. If anything else ping us in #new-hires or DM.
Jordan: Closing the loop — created a tiny note in my onboarding doc about the steps in case someone else hits this.
